messages.text: Checking on the anticipated ship date for order #Shop····.
Happy to check that for you. What's the email address on the order, so I can pull it up?

Thanks. Your A. (order Shop····) hasn't shipped yet. It's waiting on the incoming batch at our warehouse, and the current ship date on it is November 30. I'm sorry it moved past the end-of-October date we wrote to you about on October 5.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Your tracking is emailed automatically the moment it leaves.

Anything else I can check on it?

I hear you, and I'm sorry. You ordered on September 30 expecting October 3, then end of October, and now it's November 30. That's two slips, and that's on us, not on you.

What I can tell you straight: the units aren't on our shelf yet, so November 30 is the real date, and we kept your price on the bonus-antenna kit when the batch moved.

Your tracking goes out automatically the moment it ships. Is there anything you'd like me to look at on the order?
